provisions.quote: Information and records obtained in the course of a screening investigation, evaluation, examination, or treatment are confidential and are not public records
provisions.appliesTo: Records under AS 47.30.660 to 47.30.915 (evaluation, commitment and treatment)

facts.statutoryDamages: Actual damages plus $5,000, or $100,000 if the violation resulted in profit or monetary gain (AS 18.13.020)

provisions.title: Genetic privacy: private right of action
provisions.quote: A person may bring a civil action against a person who collects a DNA sample from the person, performs a DNA analysis on a sample, retains a DNA sample or the results of a DNA analysis, or discloses the results of a DNA analysis in violation of this chapter.
provisions.appliesTo: Violations of AS 18.13 (DNA samples and analysis)

private_right.note: Narrow right for genetic data only. Breach violations by businesses are unfair trade practices under AS 45.48.080(b), with damages capped at $500 actual economic damages. No general medical records right found.

crossCheck.note: Narrow genetic right. Damages of $5,000, or $100,000 with profit, verified. AS 45.48.080(b) breach route caps damages at $500 actual economic damages. No general medical records right found.
